sql: SELECT t.*, a.account_name, a.account_tier, a.duns_number, a.billing_city, a.account_owner, c.erp_customer_id, c.customer_name FROM service_tickets t JOIN crm_accounts a ON a.account_id=t.account_id LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.duns_number=a.duns_number WHERE t.ticket_id='SR-39802'
